steps.command: cat AGENTS.md docs/README.md notes/issue-70.md docs/architecture.md docs/adrs/README.md docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md docs/adrs/0002-run-background-jobs-on-postgres.md docs/glossary.md; git status --short; rg --files

cat /work/.agents/skills/docs-layout/references/philosophy.md /work/.agents/skills/docs-layout/templates/philosophy.template.md /work/.agents/skills/docs-layout/references/adopt.md; cat README.md docs/features/*.md docs/runbooks/*.md larder/*.py; git log -5 --oneline

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
import unicodedata

pages = [Path('docs/README.md'), Path('docs/philosophy.md'), Path('docs/architecture.md')]
count = 0
for page in pages:
    content = page.read_text()
    assert '[[fill:' not in content, page
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', content):
        path, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        destination = page.parent / path if path else page
        assert destination.is_file(), (page, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', destination.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', unicodedata.normalize('NFC', h).lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in slugs, (page, target)
        count += 1
print(f'Checked {count} local links and all template placeholders in the three changed pages.')
PY
 git diff --check
 git status --short
